necessary_qualifications: The broad OWR program remains unresolved by this packet.
No claim that every limit order or every non-polynomial system fails.
The counterexample has a singular sole invariant measure and does not refute prior strict-feasibility results.
Positive alternatives require certified global error or regularity and coverage information.
Operator convergence alone does not justify infimum convergence with unbounded auxiliary coefficients.
Finite symbolic and floating tests support rather than replace the analytic proofs.
The manifest needs its separately pinned external hash as a trust anchor.
